plain: Usually a test of whether a model can find one fact buried in a long text; CIMemories uses the name for a memory design.
eli5: Finding one shiny pin in a huge pile of hay.
technical: Two senses: the common one is a long-context retrieval test that hides one fact in a long input; CIMemories uses it instead for the memory architecture in which every stored memory is pasted ahead of the conversation and the model must find the relevant ones itself.
